"""Owned K299 validation; compiler acceptance remains separately pinned to S."""
import argparse,hashlib,json,runpy,signal,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--repo',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--target',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--mode',choices=['build','all'],required=True)
a=p.parse_args();R=a.repo.resolve(strict=True);O=a.out;assert not O.exists();O.mkdir(mode=0o700)
H=runpy.run_path(str(R/'scripts/lifecycle_core.py'));stop=False
def cancel(*_):
    global stop
    stop=True;H['run'].__globals__['CANCELLED']=True
for n in (signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIGINT):signal.signal(n,cancel)
env=H['controlled_env']();env.pop('CARGO_TARGET_DIR',None);env.update(RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN='1.93.1',CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='1',RUST_TEST_THREADS='1',CARGO_NET_OFFLINE='true')
proof={'schema':'zee-k299-owned-gates-1','status':'running','source_parent':H['git'](R,'rev-parse','HEAD'),'driver_sha256':H['digest'](Path(__file__)),'commands':[]}
PINNED=['scripts/tests/pdf-plugin-native.py','scripts/tests/service-fault-native.py','scripts/tests/pdf-plugin-test.py','scripts/tests/service-fault-test.py','compiler/tests/pdf_plugin_testi.rs','scripts/lifecycle_core.py','compiler/Cargo.toml','compiler/Cargo.lock','compiler/build.rs','compiler/rust-toolchain.toml']
proof.update(repo=str(R),target=str(a.target),mode=a.mode,source_tree=H['git'](R,'rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'),environment={n:env.get(n) for n in ('RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN','CARGO_BUILD_JOBS','RUST_TEST_THREADS','CARGO_NET_OFFLINE','CARGO_TARGET_DIR')},source_pins={n:H['digest'](R/n) for n in PINNED},begin_diff_sha256=hashlib.sha256(H['run'](['git','-C',R,'diff','--binary','HEAD'])).hexdigest())
def save():(O/'PROOF.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n')
def run(name,args,cwd=R/'compiler',timeout=1800):
    assert not stop
    log=O/(name+'.log');child=None;start=time.monotonic();c={'name':name,'argv':args,'status':'running'};proof['commands'].append(c);save()
    try:
        with log.open('xb') as stream:
            child=subprocess.Popen(args,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True,close_fds=True)
            while H['held_status'](child) is None:
                assert not stop and time.monotonic()-start<timeout and log.stat().st_size<24*1024**2
                time.sleep(.1)
            terminal=H['held_status'](child);c['observed_exit']=terminal
            assert log.stat().st_size<24*1024**2
            H['stop_owned'](child,grace=.2 if terminal==0 else 90);c['reaped']=child.returncode is not None;c['exit']=child.returncode
            assert log.stat().st_size<24*1024**2
            assert child.returncode==0 and not stop
            c['status']='passed';print(name+': passed',flush=True)
    except BaseException as error:c.update(status='failed',failure_type=type(error).__name__);raise
    finally:
        if child is not None and child.returncode is None:H['stop_owned'](child,grace=90);c['reaped']=child.returncode is not None;c['exit']=child.returncode
        c['seconds']=time.monotonic()-start
        if log.exists():c['log_sha256']=H['digest'](log)
        save()
try:
    if a.mode=='build':run('cargo-owners-build',['cargo','test','--locked','--test','pdf_plugin_testi','--test','service_fault_testi','--no-run'])
    else:
        run('fmt',['cargo','fmt','--all','--','--check'])
        run('counts',['cargo','run','--locked','--bin','depo_sayilari','--','--yaz'])
        run('summary',['cargo','run','--locked','--','çalıştır','../dogfood/kanit-ozeti/kaynak/ana.dil'])
        run('phase-matrix',['cargo','run','--locked','--bin','faz_test_matrisi','--','--denetle','--rapor',str(a.target/'faz-test-matrisi-k299.md')],timeout=2400)
        run('clippy',['cargo','clippy','--locked','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings'])
        run('function-trend',['cargo','run','--locked','--bin','islev_egilimi','--','--denetle'])
        run('spec-drift',['cargo','run','--locked','--bin','spec_drift','--','--denetle'])
        run('catalog-freshness',['cargo','test','--locked','--test','katalog_testi','--test','dokuman_tazelik_testi'])
        for n in ['conformance','semantic-regresyon','core-freeze']:run(n+'-guard',['bash','scripts/'+n+'-korugu.sh',proof['source_parent']],cwd=R)
        run('diff-check',['git','diff','--check'],cwd=R)
        run('secret-scan',['bash','scripts/sir-taramasi.sh'],cwd=R)
    assert H['git'](R,'rev-parse','HEAD')==proof['source_parent'] and {n:H['digest'](R/n) for n in PINNED}==proof['source_pins']
    assert H['digest'](Path(__file__))==proof['driver_sha256']
    changed=H['run'](['git','-C',R,'diff','--name-only','-z','HEAD']).split(b'\0')+H['run'](['git','-C',R,'ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard','-z']).split(b'\0')
    proof['end_overlay']={n.decode():H['digest'](R/n.decode()) for n in sorted(set(changed)) if n}
    proof.update(end_diff_sha256=hashlib.sha256(H['run'](['git','-C',R,'diff','--binary','HEAD'])).hexdigest(),source_pins_unchanged=True,source_parent_unchanged=True,driver_unchanged=True,status='passed')
except BaseException as error:proof.update(status='failed',failure_type=type(error).__name__);raise
finally:save()
